record.context_brief: Ricci-flat manifolds and the Hitchin-Thorpe-type inequality
record.original_question: Is there an interesting example of a Ricci-flat 4-manifold M with 2χ(M) > 3|τ(M)|? In particular, does the 4-sphere S^4 admit a Ricci-flat metric?

evidence.quote: Question 3.15. Is there any interesting example of a Ricci flat manifold with \(2\chi>3|\tau|\)? Does \(\mathbf{S}^4\) admit a Ricci flat metric ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background. For a closed, oriented, smooth 4-manifold M, let χ(M) denote its Euler characteristic and τ(M) its signature. A Riemannian metric g on M is called Ricci-flat if its Ricci tensor vanishes identically, Ric(g) ≡ 0. The Hitchin–Thorpe inequality states that any closed oriented 4-manifold admitting an Einstein metric satisfies 2χ(M) ≥ 3|τ(M)|, with equality only for flat manifolds or for Ricci-flat Kähler metrics on (quotients of) the K3 surface.

Problem. 
(a) Does there exist a closed, oriented, smooth 4-manifold M admitting a Ricci-flat Riemannian metric g such that the strict inequality 2χ(M) > 3|τ(M)| holds, beyond the already classically known examples (flat tori and K3-type manifolds, which lie on the equality boundary)? Equivalently, exhibit an "interesting" Ricci-flat 4-manifold satisfying this strict inequality, or prove that no such example exists. 

(b) In particular, does the 4-sphere S^4 admit a Ricci-flat Riemannian metric?
artifact.status_search_result: The existence of Ricci-flat (non-flat) metrics on the 4-sphere S^4, and more generally interesting Ricci-flat closed 4-manifolds with 2χ > 3|τ|, remains a well-known open problem in 4-dimensional Einstein/Ricci-flat geometry. Surveys of Einstein metrics on 4-manifolds (e.g., Anderson) and works on collapsing almost Ricci-flat 4-manifolds (Lott) discuss the known constraints (Hitchin–Thorpe, hyperkähler rigidity in the simply connected case) but do not resolve whether S^4 admits a Ricci-flat metric.

status_evidence.title: A Survey of Einstein Metrics on 4-Manifolds (Anderson)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses the Hitchin–Thorpe inequality 2χ ≥ 3|τ| for Einstein 4-manifolds and the rigidity of equality (flat or K3-type Ricci-flat Kähler).
status_evidence.claim: The existence question for Ricci-flat metrics on closed simply connected 4-manifolds beyond K3 (in particular S^4) is treated as open.

status_evidence.title: The Collapsing Geometry of Almost Ricci-Flat 4-Manifolds (Lott)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies almost Ricci-flat closed 4-manifolds and their topology, referencing the Hitchin–Thorpe inequality.
status_evidence.claim: No known Ricci-flat metric on S^4 is exhibited; the question is treated within the open landscape of Ricci-flat 4-manifolds.

status_evidence.title: Ricci-flat manifold — Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Lists known compact Ricci-flat 4-manifolds (flat tori, K3, Enriques quotients) and notes restrictions from Hitchin–Thorpe.
status_evidence.claim: No Ricci-flat metric on S^4 is known.
